entries.land_description: On creek with ocean, lakes, mountains, forest nearby. On route to Long Beach and West Coast Trail.
entries.notes: Work exchange on herb farm or $5/nite cabin. Two women on land with older teens (includes male). Bus stop nearby. We welcome: visitors, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs on leash. We are/have: housing/permanent structures, accessible, plumbing, electricity, woods, farm-land, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: The land is at the end of the road, and surrounded by miles of gently rolling woodlands and streams.
entries.welcomed_groups: lesbians needing time and space in which to heal, visitors, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs on leash
entries.notes: We are two womyn living on 10 acres of land. We want to open our land to campers. We especially welcome lesbians needing time and space in which to heal. Our "rule" is that everyone here respect themselves, each other, and the land. Length of stay negotiable. No charge, but all good will offerings accepted. We welcome visitors. We have: woods, camping space, women living on the land.

entries.land_description: We have houses that outline an ecology centre and Norvin Green State Forest.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, wymin seeking spirituality
entries.notes: Esanmar is a wymin's spirituality, healing centre. Wymin come here to meet other sisters, play music, hike, swim, relax, gather in circles and plan change. We believe our land is sacred and are in the process of expanding our community. We feel those who are supposed to be here will come. We are/have: 23 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians, 3
